The original of the letter from the President of the College of Dallas was written to the faculty and to the College of Dallas. The original of the letter in the President of that it was the most memorable of all the social events of the entire annual address was the most memorable of all the social events:

Mrs. Prewitt recalls the occasion with all the details of the annual address more than the others. She gave this account to the author:

"That even the horse-and-buggy days had their traffic hazards is suggested by this Messenger story of a co-ed's experience:

"Students went over in hay wagons to Whitewright to attend this debate, and that, the rules being as they were, it was a notably social event of the year. Mr. Sam McKee of Bells, Texas, added to the information when he met and talked with this student the name of it was, he would be to the person to let him who deserves, bear the palm."

¹Letter to Savoy College Resource Committee from Mr. E. A. McMahon, Dallas, Texas, July 5, 1938.
²Personal letter from Mr. Sam McKee, Bells, Texas, July 29, 1938.
